process_baseline.name: status_quo_single_route_gate_repair
process_baseline.description: Generate one Gate task family, run or draft one candidate path, audit after construction, repair same-family failures, preserve negative evidence, and repeat until blocked or anchored.
process_baseline.latest_failure_readback: The current generated Gate4 task family closed because partner_id_lookup_baseline scored 1.0 against threshold 0.8 before candidate code existed.

policy_change: Future Gate4 replacement work must separate cheap-baseline preflight, discovery-mode candidate-family comparison, and admission-grade computed-evidence validation.

modes.purpose: Rapidly compare mechanism families before admission-grade evidence.
modes.documentation_burden: lower than admission mode, but still source-pinned and claim-ceiling bounded
modes.remote_anchor_rule: no remote anchor unless a route boundary or boundary-worthy negative evidence is created
modes.discriminative_mechanism_signal_definiti: A family produces a signal only if the target cannot be matched by faithful cheap lookup, table, decoder, retrieval, imitation, graph/cache, or label-generator baselines under fair access and if an intended update/control/replay path changes behavior under real ablation.

modes.purpose: Only for candidates that survive discovery-mode family comparison.
modes.replay_requirement: Replay must recompute behavior from serialized state plus observation where applicable.
modes.remote_anchor_rule: allowed only for stable downstream-cited boundaries after acceptance gates pass
modes.claim_rule: No mechanism or readiness claim unless computed evidence supports the bounded claim.
